command: fabio environment update-staging-spark-compute --workspace <WS> --id <ENV> --compute-api release --spark-property spark.sql.shuffle.partitions=2 --custom-live-pool-support Disabled
description: Representative release Spark compute response with array properties and disabled hydration; configuration is not pool execution.
notes: The complete response can contain additional compute fields. The default CLI contract remains beta/dictionary; explicitly selected release uses beta=false and arrays. Read-merge-write preserves other values/fields but is not atomic. maxClustersToHydrateLimit is read-only and never echoed in PATCH. No publish, hydration or fallback occurs automatically.

query_examples.description: Extract one release property value from the array.
Inspect per-environment configuration, not tenant availability or warm-cluster readiness.
